basic_info.description: Nestled in a sunny and serene neighborhood of San Francisco, this charming 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath home on Goettingen Street offers incredible bay views and a bright, inviting atmosphere. The thoughtfully designed layout features one bedroom upstairs and one downstairs, providing flexibility and privacy. A skylight bathes the dining room in natural light, while the kitchen boasts breathtaking views of the bay. With a spacious garage, you'll have plenty of room for parking and storage.    This large sunny lot is 25'x 120' and boasts immense potential for expansion.    Enjoy the peaceful surroundings of this hidden gem while still being close to city conveniences. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own this home.
